s1_target_crash.evidence: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free READ of size 4 at 0x610000000350 in Variant_clear /src/open62541/src/ua_types.c:405:11. Crash address 16 bytes inside freed 192-byte region [0x610000000340,0x610000000400). DEDUP_TOKEN: Variant_clear--clear_noInit--UA_clear. Reproduced live; matches GT sink.

order_free_before_use.evidence: ASan free stack: UA_Array_delete ua_types.c:1094 <- Variant_clear ua_types.c:410 <- DataValue_clear:800 <- DataValue_copy:810. ASan alloc stack: UA_Array_copy ua_types.c:1061 (UA_calloc). Same region freed then READ at Variant_clear:405 -> free_before_use ordering witnessed by ASan.

root_cause.fix_result: exit 0, 'Execution successful' (MemoryManager: Setting memory limit to 984)
root_cause.evidence: Fix commit f4f8cdc adds `p->data = NULL;` after UA_Array_delete at ua_types.c:410. Same PoC crashes on vul and runs clean on fix => the un-nulled p->data at Variant_clear:410 is the confirmed root cause; the missing-reset lets the second clear re-enter the freed array via the guard p->data > UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL.
